head: 34c341b9039342611d3ca644a9aa9593bdad1c89
author: Timothy Schmidt
message:
wifi: cfg80211: flush deferred scan done message on interface down

When an interface goes down while a scan is running, the netdev
notifier completes the scan with ___cfg80211_scan_done(rdev, false).
That frees cfg80211's view of the request and stores the scan-done
netlink message in rdev->scan_msg. Only the next ___cfg80211_scan_done()
call sends and clears it, and until then nl80211 rejects every new scan
with -EBUSY.

That next call used to come from the driver: completing the cancelled
scan queued scan_done_wk. Since commit dab68a74e90b ("wifi: cfg80211:
don't free driver-owned scan requests"), a request the driver still owns
is only marked stale. cfg80211_scan_done() then frees it and returns
without queueing the work, so the deferred message is never sent and
scanning stays blocked until the wiphy is unregistered.

wcn36xx with firmware scan offload hits this whenever NetworkManager
cycles the interface during a scan, for example to apply a stable cloned
MAC address on (re)connection. nl80211 then returns -EBUSY indefinitely
and wpa_supplicant logs

  wlan0: CTRL-EVENT-SCAN-FAILED ret=-16 retry=1

Queue scan_done_wk when the message is deferred, so its delivery no
longer depends on the driver completing the stale request.

Fixes: dab68a74e90b ("wifi: cfg80211: don't free driver-owned scan requests")
